rules: Fill empty fields only. A value is used only when the RERA registration matches and either the RERA-registered record states it, or two independent sources agree. Prices are never applied from portals (they differ between sources and change often) - see REVIEW-round7-pilot.csv.

changes.title: Eastern Front
changes.source_type: Property portals (2 agreeing: housiey.com, propertypistol.com) - RERA no. matches
changes.note: MahaRERA P52100055529 on both sources. 2/3/4 BHK, carpet 813 (2 BHK) to 1433 (4 BHK) sq ft, RERA possession June 2028, 1 acre, 3 towers 3B+G+P+13 agree. Prices disagree (99.18 L-1.74 Cr vs 1.05-1.82 Cr all-inclusive) - not applied.

ops.value: Eastern Front by Vishal Group is a residential project near Mundhwa Chowk in Mundhwa, Pune, registered with MahaRERA (P52100055529). It has 3 towers (3 basements + ground + podium + 13 floors) on about 1 acre and offers 2, 3 and 4 BHK apartments with carpet areas from 813 to 1,433 sq ft. RERA possession is June 2028. Amenities include a swimming pool, gym, multipurpose hall, yoga deck, kids' play area and creche.
Towers placed so that no apartments face each other

changes.title: Eon Water Front
